45ee1892-2680-475d-ad94-e4c561d02886.bio: Peggy came to Hull in 1959 to sew for Rosen & Co., and met Walter at a dance hall that flooded the same night. She kept the household accounts in a green ledger for fifty-one years, and still writes every grandchild a letter on their birthday.

8bb501ba-ee54-4cd5-9a8b-19f672956fd4.bio: Walter ran the chandlery on Humber Street for thirty years and could tie a bowline one-handed. In 1998 he recorded six cassettes of sea stories; the first is digitised here.

cd657de5-3487-48d6-8aa1-8cb1804b418d.bio: Daniel is a civil engineer who has since rebuilt two of the bridges his father used to sail under.
